name: proof-of-performance
title: Proof of performance
for_each: select id,partner||' - '||name as name from deal_summary where stage in ('contracted','ended') and delivered>0

sections.title: Agreement
sections.sql: select partner,name as agreement,start_on,end_on,currency,total as partnership_value from deal_summary where id=$1

sections.title: What we promised and what went out
sections.sql: select asset,promised,delivered,remaining,state from entitlement_status where deal_id=$1 order by asset

sections.title: Delivery log
sections.note: Each line shows where its evidence is kept. A line with no evidence is checked before this report is sent.
sections.sql: select x.delivered_on,a.name as asset,ev.name as event,x.quantity,x.reach,coalesce(x.evidence,'(no evidence recorded)') as evidence from deliveries x join entitlements e on e.id=x.entitlement_id join assets a on a.id=e.asset_id left join events ev on ev.id=x.event_id where e.deal_id=$1 order by x.delivered_on,a.name

name: partner-statement
title: Partner statement
for_each: select id,partner||' - '||name as name from deal_summary where stage='contracted' and invoiced>0

sections.title: Agreement
sections.sql: select partner,name as agreement,currency,cash,contra,total,invoiced,paid from deal_summary where id=$1

sections.title: Invoices
sections.note: Contra is invoiced at market value, the same as a cash sale.
sections.sql: select i.name,i.kind,i.amount,i.due_on,i.paid_on,i.state from invoice_status i join deals d on d.name=i.deal where d.id=$1 order by i.due_on

name: match-day-run-sheet
title: Match day partner run sheet
for_each: select id,name||' '||held_on as name from events where status='scheduled' and held_on between current_date and current_date+30

sections.title: Event
sections.sql: select name,held_on,venue,audience,broadcast from events where id=$1

sections.title: What goes out, by partner
sections.note: Tick each line on the day. Record it afterwards with /deliver-event.
sections.sql: select partner,asset,kind,remaining as left_on_the_deal from event_deliverables where event_id=$1 and remaining>0 and not recorded order by partner,asset

name: sponsorship-prospectus
title: Partnership opportunities
for_each: select to_char(current_date,'YYYY-MM') as id,'Partnership opportunities '||to_char(current_date,'YYYY-MM') as name

sections.title: Available this season
sections.note: Rate card values are list prices. Packages are built around what you want to achieve.
sections.sql: select name,kind,unit,audience,unsold as available,rate from inventory where unsold>0 and $1::text is not null order by rate desc nulls last
